title: Python (programming language)
text: Python is a high-level programming language. Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. It emphasizes readability and is widely used in data science and web development.

title: Guido van Rossum
text: Guido van Rossum is a Dutch programmer best known as the creator of Python. He was born in 1956 in the Netherlands. He worked at Google and Dropbox.

title: Netherlands
text: The Netherlands is a country in Western Europe. The capital city is Amsterdam. The country is known for tulips, windmills, and cycling.

title: Amazon (company)
text: Amazon is an American multinational technology company. It was founded by Jeff Bezos in 1994. Amazon started as an online bookstore and expanded into cloud computing with AWS.

title: Jeff Bezos
text: Jeffrey Preston Bezos founded Amazon in 1994. He served as CEO until 2021. Bezos also owns Blue Origin, an aerospace company.

title: JavaScript
text: JavaScript is a programming language created by Brendan Eich in 1995 while he worked at Netscape. It is a core technology of the World Wide Web alongside HTML and CSS.

title: Brendan Eich
text: Brendan Eich created JavaScript in 1995. He later co-founded Mozilla and served as CEO of Mozilla Corporation briefly in 2014.

title: Mozilla
text: Mozilla is a free software community founded by members of Netscape. The Mozilla Corporation develops Firefox. Brendan Eich was involved in Mozilla's early leadership.

title: Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level. Its elevation is 8,849 meters (29,032 feet). It lies in the Himalayas on the border of Nepal and China (Tibet).

title: Boiling point of water
text: At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (212 degrees Fahrenheit). The boiling point decreases at higher altitudes.

title: Annus Mirabilis papers
text: In 1905, Albert Einstein published four papers including special relativity. This year is called Einstein's Annus Mirabilis. Special relativity introduced the equivalence of mass and energy.

title: Tokyo
text: Tokyo is the capital of Japan. The Tokyo metropolis has a population of approximately 14 million people. It is one of the world's most populous metropolitan areas.

title: Moons of Mars
text: Mars has two moons: Phobos and Deimos. They are small and irregularly shaped. Phobos orbits closer to Mars than Deimos.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy. A byproduct of photosynthesis is oxygen gas released into the atmosphere.

title: Alan Turing
text: Alan Mathison Turing was born in 1912 in London. He was a pioneering computer scientist and mathematician who formalized concepts of computation and helped crack Enigma codes.

title: London
text: London is the capital of England and the United Kingdom. The River Thames flows through London. It is a major global financial center.

title: Great Wall of China
text: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications built across the historical northern borders of ancient Chinese states. It is located in China and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

title: DNA
text: DNA stands for Deoxyribonucleic acid. It is a molecule that carries genetic instructions for development and function of living organisms. DNA is composed of two polynucleotide chains forming a double helix.

title: Speed of light
text: The speed of light in vacuum is exactly 299,792,458 meters per second. It is a universal physical constant denoted by c. Nothing with mass can reach this speed.

title: Battle of Waterloo
text: The Battle of Waterloo was fought on 18 June 1815 near Waterloo. Napoleon Bonaparte was defeated by the armies of the Seventh Coalition. The battle marked the end of the Napoleonic Wars.

title: Rhine
text: The Rhine is a major European river. It originates in Switzerland in the Swiss Alps. The river flows through Germany and the Netherlands to the North Sea.

title: Artificial intelligence
text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is intelligence demonstrated by machines. Machine learning is a subset of AI. Large language models are a recent development in AI research.

title: Rome
text: Rome is the capital city of Italy. It was the center of the Roman Empire. The city is known for the Colosseum and Vatican City.

title: Baking soda
text: Baking soda is sodium bicarbonate. It is used in cooking and cleaning. It reacts with acids to produce carbon dioxide gas.
